title: agentgw upstream token file
description: Tokens the gateway holds for one authorization_code upstream (docs/adr/0013). Written by `agentgw login <name>` and rewritten on every refresh; mode 0600, replaced atomically, serialised across processes by an exclusive flock on `<file>.lock`. Self-contained: copying it to another machine moves the credential. Version 1 (rev 14: issuer).

upstream.description: Upstream name this file belongs to; the gateway refuses a file whose name differs.

resource.description: RFC 8707 resource the tokens were issued for. At serve time it must identify the upstream url (same scheme, host and port; the url path equals it or extends it at a /) or equal auth.resource when that is configured; otherwise the file is refused.

issuer.description: Authorization server the tokens came from (the metadata issuer at login). When the upstream's auth.issuer is set, the gateway refuses a file whose issuer differs.

token_endpoint.description: From authorization-server metadata at login; refresh uses it without rediscovery.

client_secret.description: Only when dynamic registration issued one; then refresh uses client_secret_basic.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Refresh when fewer than 60 s remain.

refresh_token.description: Replaced on every refresh that rotates it. Empty: the access token cannot be renewed; login again when it expires.

scope.description: Space-separated scopes granted, as the token response reported them (or as requested when it did not).
